notes: Mirrors biology-replace-0013: deletes 'The dolphin is a mammal.' Derived queries phrased around the replacement class (shark) are rephrased around the original one: the chain now runs mammal → amniote, the inheritance query asks a trait every mammal has but that is hardly ever stated about dolphins by name (the diaphragm), so both have no route around the deleted class and are determinate (does not know). The worlds carry over; in w2-w4 the facts reached through the class are no longer known. Risk: a model can re-derive the deleted fact from 'dolphins are toothed whales' and 'every whale is a mammal'; the delete asks it to drop the membership however it was reached, and the direct query shows whether it did. Considered and not used: 'Do dolphins have hair at some stage of life?' (stated about dolphins by name in many 'even dolphins have hair' texts, a route around the class).
